insights: Observation within the mock scenario: layering guidance and personal expression form a coherent creative theme; the comparison gifting theme is stable.

Product match: LAVISH OUD provides an oud/spice/floral description, while PERLA is described through floral/fruity/musk notes. These verified descriptions suggest a story contrast; they do not prove a blended scent result.

Creative decision: a 15-second, text-led product film can introduce both identities with one invitation to explore. It fits the available official product photographs without inventing lifestyle footage or a new bottle.
analyses.rationale: Connect the guide signal to an approachable format, the self-expression signal to a personal-signature hook, and the official product descriptions to a two-product exploration concept. Keep gifting as a comparison instead of claiming every topic is rising. Recommend a creative hypothesis to review, with no numerical opportunity score or forecast unsupported by the inputs.

briefs.name: Your signature. In layers.
briefs.objective: Demonstrate how an explainable mock discovery can become a coherent Lavish creative review pack, with product exploration as the proposed audience action.
briefs.audience: Adult fragrance enthusiasts interested in personal expression; hypothetical creative audience, not an observed customer segment.
briefs.concept: A quiet, four-shot product study: introduce personal expression, introduce LAVISH OUD, invite exploration alongside PERLA, and close on the exact Lavish Logo. Pairing is an invitation, not a tested formula.
briefs.tone: Refined, clear, understated; warm white composition and restrained gold accents following the HTML reference.
briefs.keyMessage: Explore a fragrance signature that feels personal, through the distinct identities of LAVISH OUD and PERLA.
